description_en: Modifies the information of a simple application server, including the server name and the password that you use to log on to the server
description_zh: 修改实例的部分信息，包括实例名称，密码
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open update-instance-attribute --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new password of the simple application server. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special characters are supported:

```
()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
```

For Windows instances, the password cannot start with a forward slash (/).

For security reasons, we recommend that you use HTTPS to send requests if `Password` is specified
parameters.help_zh:
新的服务器密码。长度为8至30个字符，必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字和特殊符号中的三类字符。特殊符号可以是：

```
()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
```

其中，Windows实例不能以正斜线（/）为密码首字符。

如果传入`Password`参数，建议您使用HTTPS协议发送请求，避免密码泄露
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The name of the simple application server. The name must be 2 to 50 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or digit. Domain names are supported
parameters.help_zh: 服务器名称。长度为2-50个字符，以大小写字母数字或中文开头，可包含数字，下划线（_）或者短划线（-），同时支持域名
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
